messages:
Tara Support: Escalating FalconPay trial (acct=falconpay-trial). Customer reported sudden increase in 429s and a drop in ingestion success yesterday. They noted potential churn in account comments. Marking high priority handoff to CS.

Liam CS: Thanks @Tara. Can you paste a short log snippet, renewal date, and whether a CSM exists?

Tara Support: Renewal 2025-07-02. No active CSM. Log: `2024-12-02T09:11:27Z ERROR api: 429 token=falconpay-trial route=/v1/embeddings x-ratelimit-remaining=0`. Observed latency spikes ~900ms.

Ivy SE: Quick triage: they're sending large batches (batch=48, seq=512) to redwood-embed-4b. Short-term: reduce batch to 8, enable prefix caching, or try redwood-embed-2b for throughput. I can run a canary.

Liam CS: Draft comms plan: 1) Immediate ack within 1h, set 24h mitigation SLA. 2) SE applies canary changes and monitors 4-6h. 3) If not resolved, propose quota bump or Dedicated trial and escalate to Solutions lead. 4) Flag renewal risk = high and prepare exec note if unresolved after 72h. Roles: Ivy -> canary + metrics, Tara -> full headers/logs, Morgan -> customer outreach.

Morgan CSM: I'll send the ack and schedule a 15-min sync today. Please post the exact commands and rollback steps.

Ivy SE: Will run on canary: `rc set embed.batch_size=8 --env canary` and `rc set embed.cache_prefix=true --env canary`. Rollback: revert batch_size and disable cache_prefix. Posting 30m and 4h snapshots.

IncBot: Ticket CP-8491 created by Tara Support: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CP-8491

Tara Support: Ack sent to customer, they can join the sync. I'll attach ratelimit headers to the ticket.

Liam CS: Good. If canary shows >70% drop in 429s we keep changes and follow up. If not, prepare costed proposal for Dedicated and loop Solutions. I'll log renewal risk in CRM now.

Morgan CSM: Outreach draft ready, pasting for quick edit before send.

Tara Support: Keeping thread updated.
